refnamediv.refpurpose: Type for a list of Points

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: PtLists is the type used to store a list of Points objects (a Points is a list of points).
Such objects are returned from shape analysis functions, such as findContours for example, which returns several lists of points, each of one for each detected contour.
A PtLists object is not a Scilab matrix (it is a mlist), but its content can be extracted with the extraction operator:

itemizedlist.member: Full extraction (:): it returns a Scilab list, each item of this list is a Scilab 2xn matrix containing the coordinates of one list of points (Points).
Extraction with index (i): it returns the Points object stored at the given index.
